name: Insert Mode
instructions: a を押してカーソルの後ろに追加します。「 is awesome!」と入力し、Esc を押して NORMAL モードに戻ってください。
initialContent: VIM has multiple modes. You've been in NORMAL mode.
Press 'a' to append after the cursor and start typing.
When you're done, press 'Escape' to go back.
Your task: complete the sentence below.
